newsitem.title: USA: Hondo Colombian natgas contracts effective.
newsitem.headline: Hondo Colombian natgas contracts effective.

text.p: Hondo Oil & Gas Co said on Wednesday it received a letter from Colombian state oil company Ecopetrol declaring three previously-signed natural gas contracts effective.
Ecopetrol said there was no need for Hondo to complete and sign a fourth contract, the company said.
The contracts provide for the sale of 100 million cubic feet of natural gas by Amoco Colombia Petroleum Co, Opon Development Co and Hondo unit Hondo Magdalena Oil & Gas Ltd to Ecopetrol, Hondo said.
The natural gas came from the Opon field in Colombia's Middle Magdalena Valley.
The contracts also covered the sale of condensate and natural gas liquids and the processing of the gas stream in Ecopetrol's gas plant at El Centro.
Ecopetrol said since the pipeline built to transport gas for the Opon field was owned by the parties selling the gas, another agreement was not be necessary, Hondo Oil said.
The company had previously said a fourth contract, covering pipeline transport of the gas and liquids was required for all of the contracts to become effective.
